subject: Vendor onboarding: canonical invoice rows & submission path choice
messages:
From: Clearsky Solutions <accounts@clearsky.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@vendorco.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup: invoice submission preferences & sample payloads

Hi Logan,

We're completing our vendor onboarding checklist and want to confirm Redwood's preferred invoice submission path. Our billing system can emit either a CSV or XML extract nightly, and we also support direct upload to an SFTP or a manual email to accounts@redwood.com. A few quick questions so we can match your PO/process: 

- Do you require invoices to be submitted via the vendor portal for all vendors, or is email acceptable for low-volume suppliers?
- For CSV exports, the columns we can provide by default are: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, tax_amount, currency, vendor_tax_id. Will you need additional fields (e.g., account_code, department)?
- Can one invoice reference multiple POs, or do you prefer one PO per invoice?

I've attached a small sample CSV (sample_invoice_payload.csv) showing our current layout. We want to avoid rework, so any mapping guidance is helpful.

Thanks — looking to finalize our onboarding by next Wednesday.

Best,
Alex Chen
Clearsky Solutions — Billing
attachments: sample_invoice_payload.csv (text/csv, 2KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Clearsky Solutions <accounts@clearsky.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: invoice submission preferences & sample payloads

Alex — thanks for the sample and the clear summary. Quick answers and the path I'd suggest for a smooth go-live: 

1) Preferred path: vendor portal (preferred) for automation and PO-matching. Email is acceptable as a fallback for the initial onboarding period or for vendors who can’t support the portal. We run a pilot where we accept email for the first 2 invoices while the portal feed is validated.

2) Required fields: invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO), po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, currency are mandatory. tax_amount is optional but recommended. Additional optional fields we regularly map: vendor_tax_id, account_code (GL), department. If you can include account_code we can pre-map to our ledger during intake.

3) Multiple POs: We prefer one PO per invoice for automated matching. If you must include multiple POs on a single invoice, please put them in a delimited field (po_number_list) and keep line items tagged with the PO they belong to. That said, multi-PO invoices will trigger a manual review.

I've attached a fillable onboarding_form_v2.pdf that lists the exact headers we expect and an example mapping table. Two asks: can you confirm whether your system will populate a dedicated PO column (not just in the invoice body), and can you deliver a test CSV by May 29 so we can run the mapping?

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
From: Alex Chen <alex@clearsky.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@vendorco.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: invoice submission preferences & sample payloads

Thanks Logan — that helps a lot. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- We can export a dedicated po_number column (good).
- We can produce either CSV or XML. Our XML follows a standard invoice schema (we can send XSD if helpful).
- We cannot include PO numbers in the email subject currently, but we can ensure the PO number is a discrete CSV column.
- We typically put all taxes at the line level (tax_amount for each line). Will your ingest accept tax at line-level?

We've attached a 3-row example (clearsky_sample_rows.csv) showing multi-line items and a multi-PO test (one invoice referencing two POs in a po_number_list field). If multi-PO triggers manual review that's OK for now.

Also: SFTP is an option and might be better than email for the long term. If Redwood has SFTP credentials, we can pipe our nightly extract there.

—Alex
attachments: clearsky_sample_rows.csv (text/csv, 1.8KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Clearsky Solutions <accounts@clearsky.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: invoice submission preferences & sample payloads

Alex — good signal on the CSV/XML options. Next steps and final decisions for the pilot: 

1) Pilot approach: We'll onboard Clearsky to the portal ingestion route. Please send a formal test CSV (one of your nightly extracts or the sample_rows) to our onboarding bucket by EOD May 31. We'll run it through our mapping pipeline and confirm field-level matches.

2) Email fallback: until portal is validated, we'll accept emailed invoices to accounts+clearsky@redwood.com. Please put the PO number in the dedicated po_number column (not subject) and include invoice_number as unique. The special accounts+clearsky token will route entries to a temporary mailbox monitored by our onboarding team.

3) Multi-PO handling: acceptable but flagged for manual review. If you expect >5% of invoices to reference multiple POs, flag us and we'll assess an alternative flow.

4) SFTP: happy to evaluate; I'll connect you with our infra contact if you'd prefer SFTP for nightly batches after the pilot.

Attached are onboarding_instructions_clearsky.pdf and a final checklist. Can you confirm ETA for the test file and whether you'll try SFTP or portal first? We'll kick off mapping when we receive the test file.

Thanks all — tagging Monica and Vanessa for intake coordination.

Logan Wright
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference
attachments: onboarding_instructions_clearsky.pdf (application/pdf, 85KB)
